statement: Conditioning an odd cube-band state on AboveAnchor and x >= n^2 makes the floor defect delta = x^3 - T(x)^2 occupy a proper subinterval of 0 <= delta < 2T(x)+1. False. On the n=13 cube-band the normalized defect theta = delta/(2T(x)+1) ranges from near 0 to near 1. The mixed cell is the eighth-power comparison, not a defect cut. This is not PredClosure, not a Z5 family, not a length-11 census, and not a halt theorem.

If x is odd and T(x) is even, then T^2(x) < n^2 if and only if x^3 < n^8. This is the mixed odd-cube / even-square cell. It is strictly sharper than composing a cube-band bound x < n^3 into T^2(x)^4 < n^9. An eighth-cell even lift that returns even is FiniteProgress; on MinimalNonTerm that return is odd. This is not a claim that every leftover landing stays below n^8, not a defect restriction, and not a halt theorem.
